# QA round-1 probes with the expected result per layer, so QA can rerun them (strings only, never executed).
# Format: hook=<BLOCK|pass> deny=<DENY|pass> | <command>
# Lines starting with `residual |` are documented residuals that stay allowed; they are listed, not asserted.
#
# M1: bypasses that used to pass both layers.
hook=BLOCK deny=pass | x=sh; git pu$x origin main
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | git send-pack ../bare HEAD:refs/heads/main
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | /usr/lib/git-core/git-push origin main
# Alias through -c with the value attached, and --config-env=<value> (the deny list is case sensitive: Alias passes it).
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | git -calias.p=push p origin main
hook=BLOCK deny=pass | git -cAlias.p=push p origin main
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | git --config-env=alias.p=X p origin main
# m5: relative writes after cd/pushd into .claude.
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | cd .claude && truncate -s0 settings.json
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | cd .claude/hooks && : > guard-bash.mjs
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | pushd .claude; rm settings.json
# Reading .claude stays allowed.
hook=pass deny=pass | cat .claude/settings.json
hook=pass deny=pass | ls .claude
hook=pass deny=pass | grep -n deny .claude/settings.json
# Deploy tools with `deploy` as the first argument; text commands that only mention it stay allowed.
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | eb deploy
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | serverless deploy
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | sls deploy
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | /usr/local/bin/sls deploy
hook=pass deny=pass | echo deploy
hook=pass deny=pass | grep deploy docs
hook=pass deny=pass | git log --grep deploy
# Wrapper forms of narrowed CLIs: the deny list now covers them too.
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | sudo kubectl get pods
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | env kubectl get pods
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | env FOO=bar kubectl get pods
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | bash -c "kubectl get pods"
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | sh -c 'kubectl get pods'
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | eval kubectl get pods
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | xargs -n 1 kubectl get
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | sudo ./deploy.sh
hook=BLOCK deny=DENY | bash -c "./deploy.sh"
# Documented residuals (still allowed by both layers).
residual | perl -e 'system("git","push","origin","main")'
residual | ln -s /usr/bin/git /tmp/g; /tmp/g push origin main
residual | echo Z2l0IHB1c2ggb3JpZ2luIG1haW4= | base64 -d | bash
residual | bash /tmp/x.sh
residual | sh < /tmp/x.sh
residual | echo '[alias] q = push' >> .git/config
residual | parallel git ::: push
residual | k9s
residual | ansible-playbook site.yml
residual | docker login
residual | gh pr review 1 --approve
residual | gh secret set NAME
